scope: Resident owner controller authorization, actor-aware rule input, existing pet command protocol repair
behavior: Controller authorization runs at application time, including queued input restored from checkpoints.
Member healing, recovery settings, strategy and pet controls use the member actor, including when the leader is dead.
Foreign human control through memberId, memberIds or configuration target is rejected without changing rule state or RNG.
All prepare/takeover/pause/resume aliases require leader pause authority; multiple account clocks cannot be paused.
Global orders that mutate foreign human behavior remain unavailable until scoped team consent exists; NPC commands and personal pause remain available.
Existing pet actions pass protocol validation and retain rule-level pet, inventory and target checks.

warnings: Existing large scene and battle-model chunks remain.

limitations: Two human controllers were tested in isolated rule/Worker rooms, not a multi-account asset-backed end-to-end dungeon.
Participant private projections, independent out-of-combat activities, character transfers and multi-account atomic asset commits remain unfinished.
Shared visitors remain denied the leader private presentation; no old database authority fallback is enabled.
No browser playtest rerun for this server authorization change. Prior preparation-scene and crash observations are in instance-lifecycle-2026-10-01.json with their own runtime versions.
No capacity or native browser crash resolution guarantee.
